notes.text: You can send up to 25,000 a day in Canadian or US dollars. A payment over that is turned down with a message that says why.
Cash deposits and withdrawals of CAD 10,000 or more are reported, and the money still moves.
A payment to or from a person on a sanctions list is stopped. The message never says why.
Every screen now meets the web accessibility standard WCAG 2.2 A and AA, in the light and dark themes, and an error shows beside the field that caused it.
